title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+storage 73 m2 on the edge of "Bajram Curri" Boulevard with a view of "Lana"
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale + small storage room where A+++ washing machine is installed/shelves for shoes and detergents. 73 m2 on the edge of "Bajram Curri" Boulevard inside the Vogel Ring with a view of "Lana" and the V.Shanto intersection. Existing building, 5-story building, 5th floor, height 3.15 m, only 2 entrances to the floor. Restored from scratch, electrical, hydraulic, skating/painting, parquet, double-glazed windows, quality furniture from "VIP Saloti", "LUBE" kitchen with dishwasher and Candy A+++ appliances, "Inverter" air conditioner in all rooms and living room. Small storage room where A+++ washing machine is installed/shoe and detergent shelves. With regular ownership documentation. Sold by the owner himself
